avis.texte: I have acne prone skin and blemishes from teenage years. A friend of mine used this and I didnt know until I complimented how different her skin looked. I gave it a shot and use this twice a week to get used to it. I am about to upgrade and add the 300 on one of the two days I use this product. I looked at the reviews on the 300 and was suprised. This isnt a "use everyday" product. You have to ween it into your skin care routine. On my "reedle" nights, I only cleanse, reedle, use my barrier essence and moisturizer. My barrier essence has peptides and ceramides which is good to use. If you use reedle and slap on a bunch of other products, theres a high chance to get irritation or breakouts. Dont use on breakout days or simply dont put reedle on your breakout spots. This is a good product so your serums and products can absorb better without abrasive treatments. The trick is the right serums, spf, and moisturizer. I have noticed a difference with my skin and do recommend, only if you use it properly. Its not an instant gratification type of thing. With the right skincare routine, this is golden. Hope this review helps someone.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: If you've been searching for a skincare product that actually delivers on the promise of glass skin, the VT Reedle Shot (often called needle shot) is an absolute game-changer. I was skeptical about the "micro-needle" concept at first, but after adding it to my nightly routine, I am completely hooked. Here is why this viral product deserves all the hype: • Texture Transformation: Within just a week of use, the stubborn texture around my cheeks and forehead completely smoothed out. My skin feels incredibly soft, almost like it's been professionally airbrushed. • Maximum Product Absorption: Because it utilizes microscopic, mineral-derived spicules to create micro-channels in the skin, it acts as a booster. Everything I apply afterward—hyaluronic acid, snail mucin, or ceramides—sinks in instantly and works twice as hard. • Radiant Glow: It has noticeably faded my post-acne hyperpigmentation and evened out my skin tone, leaving me with a healthy, lit-from-within radiance that I haven't seen in years.
